curriculum.lesson_evidence: Comparing two poems means tracking a shared focus (e.g. waiting) while noticing how techniques create similar or different effects. Synthesis states what the comparison reveals, not just two separate summaries.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Compare how two poems treat light, naming one similarity and one difference in effect.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: Shared topic/technique plus divergent effect; evidence from both.

CHECK
Writing parallel summaries without a comparative insight.

INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Complete a compare table for two poems and write a synthesis paragraph with paired evidence.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
